scope.new_resolution: Select corrected named-response prospective prediction within the existing original 79-electrode target; retain literal source replay and published historical result separately. Resolve the stored category roster/window and current caller semantics without asserting historical recipe parity.
scope.interpretation: This is a construction contract and source decision. Existing historical reproduction/improvement contracts remain binding and unqualified. No runner automatically consumes or scores this prospective outcome. A later reviewed operator protocol and full-panel comparator are still required.

prediction_family.representation_definition: Exactly named response columns 0 through 818; exclude trial_type, img_cat and temp_cond metadata.
prediction_family.selection_reason: The retained producer writes three metadata fields before the 819 named neural responses, and full-data fitting selects those named responses. Literal current CV selects positional columns 2:821, which contains temp_cond and omits the final response sample. Corrected representation is selected prospectively, not asserted to reproduce the unknown historical result-producing revision.
prediction_family.fold_contract: Freeze one exact complete prospective fold manifest before candidate/reference comparison, using the retained original one-condition-per-category without-replacement recipe. Reuse identical folds and all support for candidate and competent reference. Existing engineering manifests are prospective, not recovered historical assignments; no favorable reseeding, subset or replacement split.

reference.primary: DN with category input scaling S
requirements: Fit a competent DN-S reference on the same named-response training support, with documented initialization, original scalar-SSE least_squares objective and convergence/optimization diagnostics.
Retain source parameter bounds, timing/category representation, finite fitting budget and all failures; a numerically incomplete or weaker reference cannot lower the target.
Keep original unscaled DN and all three regional summaries. Output scaling P and full-fit quality are not replacements for DN-S held-condition prediction.
A fixed zero engineering control is not a fitted reference, reproduction result, improvement result or AI evaluation.

prediction_family.metric_contract: Inherit unchanged selected source R-squared/NaN behavior, condition rounding to three decimals, fold and electrode means to four, and all V1-V3/VOTC/LOTC regional summaries. Preserve undefined outputs and every condition/fold/electrode; never silently drop failed coordinates. Retain 1,000-electrode-bootstrap regional summaries as descriptive, not independent-participant superiority inference.
prediction_family.output_roles: Predictions and source-support records are mandatory audit/recomputation artifacts, not author-prediction equality targets. Selected scientific metric/figure companions retain their original roles.
prediction_family.prospective_reproduction_claim: At most reproduction of the explicitly reconstructed matched prospective DN/DN-S prediction assay once its reference and protocol qualify. It is not exact historical unseeded-CV numerical reproduction.
prediction_family.prospective_improvement_claim: At most improvement over a competent matched prospective DN-S reference on this named-response assay, after complete-support meaningful-effect and dependence-aware comparison criteria are frozen. It does not by itself establish surpassing the published Figure3C number or current SOTA.

historical_and_literal_attribution.source_positional_cv: Separately attributed literal retained-code replay, with its original positional target representation; do not pool, substitute or compare its values as if they were named neural-response scores.
historical_and_literal_attribution.published_historical_result: Keep the actual published result and any recovered historical arrays independently attributed. Historical result-producing code, preprocessing lineage, unseeded folds and numeric parity remain unresolved.
historical_and_literal_attribution.paper_win_gate: The unchanged improvement contract's paper_win_requires, including published-result calibration, remains necessary for a historical paper-relative win. The prospective outcome is separately labeled and cannot bypass that gate.

biological_family.regional_findings: Figure4-7 responsive-region adaptation hierarchy and mechanistic displays retain their own source cohort/recipe; they are not uniformly a 26-electrode task and are not established by held-out prediction improvement.
biological_family.category_findings: Main Figure8-9 category-selective analysis uses the original stored threshold0.5 roster after excluding stored SCRAMBLED preferences: 36 rows minus10 equals26. Source identities and all26 ordered entries are retained in source-resolution-join.v1.json.

availability.g03_scope: Only the retained parent metadata tree identifies a child tree. Child assets, annex identity, array availability and numerical compatibility are not yet established; do not force a25 subset or assume26 is contained in79.

timing_window.interpretation: Authenticated author variable, not a fitted result or inferred duration.

biological_family.caller_limits: Current retained callers expose threshold/scaling defaults, sequential first-pulse estimation, P-versus-S mechanism differences, and Figure8/9 indexing/aggregation variants recorded precisely in source-resolution-join.v1.json. These are static source facts, not demonstrated numerical failures or proof of the historical publication recipe. Author-script defaults must not silently replace the paper's main0.5/S mechanism.

access_and_isolation.roles: Prepared training response means and stimulus/category/fold identities are declared common assistance; query responses, fitted reference parameters, predictions and scoring diagnostics remain evaluator-only. Only the code condition receives the declared author code. Algorithm-bearing local producer code is not automatically common data.
access_and_isolation.cross_fold_exposure: Training responses in one fold contain another fold's query responses. A persistent candidate session over folds leaks targets. Freeze the candidate program/procedure before evaluation and enforce fresh per-fold candidate state without cross-fold response/context carryover. Sequential delivery or commitment alone does not prove provider/process isolation.
access_and_isolation.qualification: Fresh-context/provider isolation and delivered assistance manifests remain unqualified. The prior trusted non-learning control cannot resolve these limits.

activation_gaps: Reviewed finite operator protocol binding exact named-response input identities, all79 support, immutable prospective folds, equal participant budgets and protected query delivery.
Competent matched DN-S and required unscaled DN references with documented optimization convergence and complete output evidence; no fits are authorized by this metadata.

Full-region/full-panel superiority rule, meaningful effect, uncertainty respecting four participants/electrode nesting/reused folds, and separate reproduction tolerances. No scalar reduction, margin, win or admission is invented here.
Fresh candidate state or frozen program enforcement preventing cross-fold target exposure; complete predictions frozen before evaluator target access.
For historical equivalence: publication recipe/revision, original folds and complete reference numbers. For category biology: G03 support and explicit paper-versus-caller recipe reconciliation.
